meta.title: Video Editing for Content Creators | Double Dag Productions
meta.description: You shoot it, I cut it. Professional video editing for YouTubers, podcasters, and creators who'd rather make content than sit in a timeline.

hero.heading: You shoot it. I cut it.
hero.lead: You have fun. Leave the work to me.
hero.intro: Editing eats hours you don't have. Send me your footage and I'll turn it into something worth posting, so you spend your time filming instead of stuck in a timeline at midnight.

steps.title: Upload Your Footage
steps.body: Drop your raw clips in your own file-sharing service — Dropbox is fine — or I can send you a link to upload everything. No special export, no formatting rules. Just get it to me.

steps.title: I Cut the Story
steps.body: Not just an assembly of your clips in order. Pacing, structure, hooks, the stuff that actually keeps people watching.

steps.title: You Get It Back Ready to Post
steps.body: Formatted for wherever it's going. Captions and graphics included if you want them.

items.title: Long-Form Creators
items.body: YouTubers, podcasters, vloggers who need consistent weekly or biweekly turnaround without burning out on the edit.

items.title: Short-Form Creators
items.body: Reels, TikTok, Shorts. High volume, fast turnaround, cut for the scroll.

items.title: Anyone Done Teaching Themselves Premiere
items.body: You already have a full-time job being the talent. You don't need a second one in the timeline.

why.heading: Broadcast chops, creator turnaround.
why.body: 20+ years cutting documentaries and series for PBS, National Geographic, Smithsonian, and The Great Courses. Emmy-recognized editorial work. That's the same story sense going into your content, not just cuts on the beat from a preset pack.

items.title: Short-Form / Social
items.body: Fast-turnaround edits for Reels, TikTok, and Shorts.

items.title: Long-Form / YouTube
items.body: Full edits for YouTube, vlogs, and episodic content.

retainerNote.linkLabel: Ask about a standing editorial retainer
retainerNote.after: so your queue never backs up.

socialCuts.heading: Short-form & vertical
socialCuts.intro: Reels, TikTok, and Shorts cuts — the same vertical work shown on the portfolio.

items.question: Do I need to shoot a certain way?
items.answer: No. Send me what you've got. If you want shot list tips before you film, ask, happy to help.

items.question: How fast is turnaround?
items.answer: Depends on length and complexity, but most short-form turns around in days, not weeks. Rush available.

items.question: Can you do captions, thumbnails, or graphics?
items.answer: Yes, all add-ons. Ask for a quote with your project.

items.question: What if I post every week?
items.answer: That's what the retainer option is for. Reserved editing time so you're never waiting in a queue.

cta.heading: Ready to hand off the edit?
cta.body: Send your footage and tell me what it's for. I'll take it from there.
